title: Grilled Brazilian Beef Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make recipe for grilled beef skewers with a Brazilian twist. Marinate the beef in a mix of aromatic spices and then grill to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together aromatic, dense, and 2 tablespoons of olive oil
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 135°F
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired
